seen = set()
components = []
for r in range(len(grid)):
    for c in range(len(grid[0])):

            cells = [(r, c)]
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                cr, cc = q.pop(0)
                for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:

                    if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and grid[nr][nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in seen:

                        cells.append((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))
            components.append((color, cells))
